verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs say customers can run its models on infrastructure they control. Delivery is a container with a Helm chart for Kubernetes and an air-gapped Enterprise option, and the open-source Marker, Surya and Chandra stack can also be self-hosted for free. The managed on-prem path requires an Enterprise contract, and evidence is first-party only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments; documentation of feature parity (pipelines, extraction, segmentation) between on-prem and the hosted API.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run the extraction stack in my own VPC or fully self-hosted when documents can't leave my infrastructure

citations.quote: Customers can run our models on infrastructure they control with an Enterprise contract.
